content: मगधः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a country, the southern part of Bihar; अस्ति मगधेषु पुष्पपुरी नाम नगरी <ls>Dk. 1</ls>; अगाधसत्त्वो मगधप्रतिष्ठः <ls>R. 6. 21</ls>. .²2 A bard, minstrel. .{@-धाः@} (<ab>pl.</ab>) The people of Magadha, the Magadhas. .{@-धा@} .²1 The town of the Magadhas. .²2 Long pepper.
